title: Welcome to IATC!
where: The first day in class, Room 212.

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: Hello! Welcome to IATC. I'm Mr Said. I'm your teacher.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Hello, Mr Said. My name is Saad.

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: Hello, Saad. Are you a new student?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Yes, I am.

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: This is Fahad. He is your classmate.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Hello, Saad. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Fahad.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I'm from Riyadh. And you?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: I'm from Qassim.

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: This is my class. It's FND 68.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Thank you, Mr Said.

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: Sit down, please.

title: Good Morning, Class!
where: The start of the lesson. Mr Ibrahim says hello to the class.

lines.speaker: Mr Ibrahim
lines.text: Good morning, class! How are you today?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: We're fine, thank you!

lines.speaker: Mr Ibrahim
lines.text: Hello, Turki. How are you?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: I'm very well, thanks. And you?

lines.speaker: Mr Ibrahim
lines.text: I'm OK, thank you. Who is your partner?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: My partner is Saud.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Hello, Mr Ibrahim.

lines.speaker: Mr Ibrahim
lines.text: Hello, Saud. Is this your book?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Yes, it is. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Mr Ibrahim
lines.text: OK. Sit down, please.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: How are you, Saud?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Fine, thanks!

title: At the College Café
where: The college café before class.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Good morning!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Good morning! How are you today?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I'm fine, thank you. A cup of tea, please.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: With milk and sugar?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Milk, please. No sugar, thanks.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Here you are.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Thank you. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: It's three riyals.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Here you are.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Thanks. Have a nice day!

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: You too. See you later!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: It's a lovely day today!

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes, it is. Bye!

title: What's This in English?
where: The classroom. Faisal asks Yousef some words.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Yousef, what's this in English?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: It's a pen.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: And this?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: It's a notebook.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: What's in your bag?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: My English book, a pencil and a camera.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: A camera? Is this your phone?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: Yes, it is. And this is my car key.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: It's an apple. And this is an orange.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: What's this in the classroom?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: It's a computer. And that's the board.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Thanks, Yousef!

title: My New ID Card
where: The student office. Mr Hamdan gives Abdullah his ID card.

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: Hello. What's your first name?

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: My first name is Abdullah.

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: And what's your surname?

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: Alharbi.

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: What's your student number?

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: It's nine, nine, three, four, one, six.

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: Thank you. This is your ID card.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: Oh, my name is in capital letters!

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: Yes. And this is your photograph.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: What's my group?

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: Group 3. There are eight students in Group 3.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: And how many books?

lines.speaker: Mr Hamdan
lines.text: Ten books. Here you are!

title: Where Are You From?
where: The classroom. Rayan and Ali ask Mr Adam about his country.

lines.speaker: Rayan
lines.text: Mr Adam, where are you from?

lines.speaker: Mr Adam
lines.text: I'm from England. It's a country in Europe.

lines.speaker: Rayan
lines.text: What's the capital of England?

lines.speaker: Mr Adam
lines.text: London. Where are you from, Rayan?

lines.speaker: Rayan
lines.text: I'm from Tabuk, in Saudi Arabia.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: And Mr Karim? Where's he from?

lines.speaker: Mr Adam
lines.text: He's from Egypt. Look at the map. Egypt is in Africa.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: What's the capital of Egypt?

lines.speaker: Rayan
lines.text: It's Cairo!

lines.speaker: Mr Adam
lines.text: Very good. IATC has teachers from all over the world.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Where is Mr Ken from?

lines.speaker: Mr Adam
lines.text: He's from Australia.

title: Who Is This?
where: The canteen. Saleh shows Majed some photos on his phone.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Look at these photos!

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Who is this?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: This is my friend. His name is Bader.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Where is he from?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: He's from Jeddah. He's a student in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: And who are these people?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: They are my cousins, Hamza and Talal. They're from Abha.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Are they students?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Yes, they are.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: And this person?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: This is my grandmother. Her name is Noura. She's from Hail.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is she a teacher?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: No, she isn't. She's at home.

title: Twelve Plus Eight?
where: Room 13, the maths room. Mr Tariq asks questions.

lines.speaker: Mr Tariq
lines.text: Good morning! Open your books at page fourteen, please.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Page fourteen. OK.

lines.speaker: Mr Tariq
lines.text: Fahad, twelve plus eight?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Twenty!

lines.speaker: Mr Tariq
lines.text: Very good. Saud, nineteen minus four?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Fifteen.

lines.speaker: Mr Tariq
lines.text: Yes! Eleven plus six?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Sixteen?

lines.speaker: Mr Tariq
lines.text: No, sorry. It's seventeen.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Mr Tariq, are you from Riyadh?

lines.speaker: Mr Tariq
lines.text: No, I'm not. I'm from Jordan. How old are you, Fahad?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I'm eighteen years old.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: And I'm nineteen.

title: My Brothers
where: The library. Fawaz shows Omar a photo.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Is this a photo of your brothers?

lines.speaker: Fawaz
lines.text: Yes. We're at the Kingdom Tower.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: It's a very tall tower!

lines.speaker: Fawaz
lines.text: Yes, and there's a big mall.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: How old is this brother?

lines.speaker: Fawaz
lines.text: That's Mansour. He's twenty-five. He's tall.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: And this brother?

lines.speaker: Fawaz
lines.text: That's Ibrahim. He's twenty-nine. He's married.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Is he short?

lines.speaker: Fawaz
lines.text: No, he isn't. I'm short! I'm twenty-two.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I'm twenty-one. What's your bus number to the tower?

lines.speaker: Fawaz
lines.text: Bus number twenty-three.

title: Welcome to Riyadh!
where: A hotel in Riyadh. Nasser meets two visitors.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: Hello! Are you on holiday?

lines.speaker: Imran
lines.text: Yes, we are. We're from Pakistan.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: Welcome to Riyadh! What's your job?

lines.speaker: Imran
lines.text: I'm a doctor in a big hospital in Lahore.

lines.speaker: Bilal
lines.text: And I'm an engineer.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: How is Riyadh?

lines.speaker: Imran
lines.text: It's fantastic! The buildings in the city centre are beautiful.

lines.speaker: Bilal
lines.text: And the food is really good.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: Is your hotel good?

lines.speaker: Bilal
lines.text: Yes, it's near the city centre. It's very nice.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: And the weather?

lines.speaker: Imran
lines.text: Hot! It's awful in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: Yes, it's very hot in September!

title: Jobs at the Airport
where: King Khalid International Airport. Nawaf and Majed meet Nawaf's brother Khalid.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Look at all the people at the airport! What's his job?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: He's a police officer. His name is Faisal.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is he a soldier?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: No, he isn't. He's a police officer.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: And that man? Is he a bus driver?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: Yes, he is. His bus is for the passengers.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Who's the man with the bag?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: He's a businessman from China.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: And the man in the café?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: He's a chef. His food is very good!

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Khalid, what's your job?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: I'm an engineer here. I'm not a builder!

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Our cousin is a nurse. He works in a hospital.

title: The Student Form
where: The student office. Mr Fahd completes Yasser's form.

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: Good morning. This is the student form. What's your full name?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: Yasser Alqahtani.

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: What's your nationality?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: I'm Saudi.

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: What's your address?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: 22 Olaya Street, Riyadh. I live here now.

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: What's your phone number?

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: And your email address?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: yasser.q@email.com.

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: Are you married?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: No, I'm not. I'm single.

lines.speaker: Mr Fahd
lines.text: Thank you. Your personal information is complete.

title: The Charity Walk
where: A park in Riyadh. The coach and two students start a charity walk.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Good morning, everyone! We're all here for the charity walk.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Is the walk long, Coach?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Yes, it's ten kilometres. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: Yes, we are! We're very excited.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: The walk is for a children's hospital. We help the children.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I'm tired! Are you tired, Badr?

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: No, I'm not. I'm strong!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: My brother isn't here. He's at work.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Look! We climb that hill now.

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: OK! We aren't tired. We're happy!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Well done, boys. You're fantastic!

title: Where's the Bus Station?
where: The town centre. Ziyad is new in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Excuse me! Where is the bus station, please?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sorry, I'm not from here. I don't know.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: That's OK. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Excuse me. Is the bus station near here?

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.text: Yes, it is. It's over there.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Sorry? I don't understand.

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.text: Over there, next to the bank.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Ah! Thanks a lot!

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: And is the town centre far?

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.text: No, it isn't. It's ten minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Thank you very much!

title: You're the Winner!
where: The college corridor. Talal shows Mansour the new magazine.

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Mansour, look! Your photo is in the college magazine!

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Really? Am I the winner?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, you are! All your answers are correct.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: I'm very happy! How many questions are there?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Forty questions.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Are they easy?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: No, they aren't. Some questions are very difficult.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Is the magazine interesting?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, it is. It isn't boring.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: English is important for us.

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, but our classroom is very noisy!

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Ha ha! Yes, it is.

title: Our Family Tree
where: The library. Faisal looks at Abdulaziz's homework.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Is this your family tree?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: Yes, it is. This is our family.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Who are your parents?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: My father is Mohammed, and my mother is Latifa.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: How many children are there?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: Four: three sons and a daughter.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Is your brother Sami married?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: Yes. His wife is Hessa. Their son is Khalid.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: How old is Khalid?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: He's three. He's very polite!

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Where are your grandparents?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: They're in Qassim. Their house has a big garden.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Our grandparents are in Hail.

title: My Father's Office
where: The canteen. Majed asks Talal and his brother Yasser about their family.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Talal, what's your father's job?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: He's a bank manager. My father's office is in a big bank.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is it near your home?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, it is. It's five minutes by car.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: And you, Yasser?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: I'm an accountant. My company is in the city centre.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is your office big?

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: No, it's small. But my boss's office is very big!

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: What's your mother's job?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: She's a part-time teacher. My mother's school is near our house.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: And your grandfather?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: He has a small hotel in Taif. My grandfather's hotel is very good!

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: My uncle's job is in a hotel too. He's a chef.

title: Who Is Your Best Friend?
where: The college garden at the break.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Who is your best friend, Sultan?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: My best friend is Omar. We're both students at IATC.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Where is he from?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: He's from a small village in the north, near Tabuk.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: What's he like?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: He's very funny and clever.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Is he tall?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes, he is. He has short black hair and brown eyes.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Is his brother a student?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes. His brother is at university in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: What do you do together?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: We play football and chat. He has a lot of friends!

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: My best friend is my cousin, Nayef. He's very kind.

title: The Big Match
where: The sports centre. Coach Nabil talks to the college team.

lines.speaker: Coach Nabil
lines.text: Good afternoon, team! We have a match on Thursday.

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: Where is it, Coach?

lines.speaker: Coach Nabil
lines.text: At the sports centre, at five o'clock.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Who is the other team?

lines.speaker: Coach Nabil
lines.text: Riyadh Technical College. They have a very good player.

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: We have good players too! I have twenty goals this year.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Badr is our best player.

lines.speaker: Coach Nabil
lines.text: Please bring your blue shirts and white shorts.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Our fans have a big flag!

lines.speaker: Coach Nabil
lines.text: Yes, our classmates are very excited.

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: We want to win the cup!

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Football is a great sport.

lines.speaker: Coach Nabil
lines.text: OK. Let's practise now!

title: Can I Take a Message?
where: A phone call to the student office.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Good afternoon. Student Office.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Hello. Can I speak to Mr Karim, please?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Certainly. What's your name?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Saud Alrashid.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: How do you spell your surname?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: A-L-R-A-S-H-I-D.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Thank you. Hold on, please. I'm connecting you …

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Sorry, Mr Karim isn't here. Can I take a message?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Yes, of course. Please ask him to call me.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: What's your number?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: And your email?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: saud.r@email dot com.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Thank you. Goodbye!

title: Lunch at the Café
where: The college café at lunchtime. Three friends talk about food and sport.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I'm hungry! What do you eat for lunch?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I eat sandwiches in the café. I don't like fast food.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: I love kabsa. My mother's kabsa is delicious!

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: What do you drink?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I drink orange juice. I don't drink a lot of cola.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: I drink Arabic coffee, and I eat dates.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: What do you do after college?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I go swimming. It's my favourite sport.

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: I play tennis with my cousin.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Tennis? Is it exciting?

lines.speaker: Nasser
lines.text: Yes, it is! And food after sport is great.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Let's eat now!

title: The Twins
where: The classroom. Saleh meets the twins Ali and Abbas.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Are you two twins?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Yes, we are! I'm Ali, and this is Abbas.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Do you like the same things?

lines.speaker: Abbas
lines.text: No, we don't! I love horse riding. Ali doesn't like it.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: I love reading. Abbas doesn't like books!

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Do you like camping?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Yes, I do. Sometimes I go camping in the mountains.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Do you like cooking, Abbas?

lines.speaker: Abbas
lines.text: Yes, I do. My kabsa is the best!

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: That's true!

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Do you both like animals?

lines.speaker: Abbas
lines.text: Yes, we do. Our grandfather has a camel and two horses.

title: At the Indian Restaurant
where: An Indian restaurant in Riyadh. Joseph is the waiter.

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.text: Good evening! Welcome. Here's the menu.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Thank you. Do you speak Arabic?

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.text: Yes, a little. I speak four languages.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Wow! Where are you from?

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.text: I'm from the Philippines. I live and work in Riyadh now.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Is the chicken curry spicy?

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.text: Yes, it's very spicy.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: I don't like spicy food. I'd like the chicken and rice, please.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: I love spicy food! The curry, please.

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.text: And to drink?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Two orange juices, please.

lines.speaker: Joseph
lines.text: Thank you. Our customers come from many countries, and they order in English or Arabic.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: You're a very good waiter!

title: Things from Many Countries
where: The college car park. Majed and Ziyad talk about cars and teachers.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Your father's car is very nice. Is it Japanese?

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Yes, it is. And my brother's car is German.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: What about your phone?

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: It's a Chinese phone. And my computer is American.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Where are our teachers from?

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Mr Adam is British. Mr Karim is Egyptian.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: And Mr Imran?

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: He's Pakistani. He speaks Urdu and English.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: We're all Saudi Arabian students.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Yes. But our coffee is Turkish today!

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Ha ha! And our pizza is Italian!

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Our college has a lot of nationalities.

title: At the Sports Shop
where: A sports shop in the mall. Faris wants some new things.

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: Excuse me. How much is this sports bag?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: It's seventy riyals.

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: And how much are these football shoes?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: They're ninety riyals. They're on sale.

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: And a pair of socks?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Fifteen riyals.

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: OK. The bag, the shoes and the socks, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: That's one hundred and seventy-five riyals. Cash or card?

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: Cash. Here's two hundred.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Thank you. Here's your change: twenty-five riyals.

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: Can I have a receipt, please?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: Faris
lines.text: Thanks. The prices here are good!

title: What Time Is Our Lesson?
where: The first day of the week. Nawaf and Fahad ask Mr Said about the timetable.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Excuse me, Mr Said. What time is our first lesson?

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: It's at half past one.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: And what time do we finish?

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: At ten to eight in the evening.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Do we study on Friday?

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: No. We study from Sunday to Thursday. Friday and Saturday are the weekend.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: When is English Lab?

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: On Wednesday, at half past one.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: And IT?

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: On Thursday, at half past five.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: What time is the break?

lines.speaker: Mr Said
lines.text: At ten past three. And there's another break at six o'clock.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Thank you! I'm always here early.

title: Your Daily Routine
where: The canteen. Omar asks Abdulrahman about his day for a class project.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: What time do you wake up, Abdulrahman?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: I wake up early and pray. Then I sleep again!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: What time do you get up?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: At nine o'clock. I have a shower and get dressed.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: What do you have for breakfast?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: Eggs, toast and tea, with my family.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: When do you have lunch?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: At twelve o'clock. Then I leave home at quarter to one.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: How do you go to college?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: By bus. I get home at half past eight.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: And dinner?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: I have dinner with my brothers, and I go to bed at eleven.

title: A Healthy Lifestyle?
where: The gym at college. Nawaf and Hamad ask Talal about his lifestyle.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Talal, is your lifestyle healthy?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, I think so. I always have breakfast before college.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: How often do you walk?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: I usually walk for thirty minutes in the evening.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Do you eat fast food?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Sometimes, with my friends. But I often eat fruit and vegetables.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I never eat vegetables!

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: That's not healthy, Hamad!

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: How often do you watch TV?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Twice a week. I'm very busy with homework.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: What do you do at the weekend?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: I usually stay at home and relax with my family.

title: Our Friday Plan
where: Thursday evening at home. Saad and his brother Bader talk about Friday.

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: What do we do on Friday, Saad?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: In the morning, Dad drives us to the mosque.

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Then we visit our grandparents.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Yes. Our uncle cooks kabsa for everybody.

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Do we go shopping in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Yes. I want to buy a new phone for you!

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Thanks! Can we stop at a café?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Of course. I want a coffee.

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: And in the evening?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Dad invites three friends to dinner.

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Do you go out at night?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: No. I write my homework and go to bed early.

title: Let's Go to the Island!
where: Captain Saleh's house in Jeddah on Thursday evening.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Dad, how often do you fly?

lines.speaker: Captain Saleh
lines.text: Three times a week. I fly between Jeddah and Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Do you have breakfast at home?

lines.speaker: Captain Saleh
lines.text: No, I don't. I have coffee and dates at the airport.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Do you work tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Captain Saleh
lines.text: No, I don't. It's the weekend.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Let's go to the island!

lines.speaker: Captain Saleh
lines.text: Good idea! We can take our boat.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Can we swim at the beach?

lines.speaker: Captain Saleh
lines.text: Yes. The sea is beautiful there.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: How long is the journey?

lines.speaker: Captain Saleh
lines.text: About thirty minutes by boat.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: You're the best dad!

title: A Call from Abha
where: A phone call. Khalid is on holiday in Abha. Hamza is in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Hi Khalid! Where are you?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: I'm in Abha with my family. It's amazing!

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: What's the weather like?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: It's wonderful. It's only eighteen degrees in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Really? It's thirty-five degrees in Riyadh!

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: At night it's cold, and in the morning there's fog.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: Does it rain?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: Yes, sometimes it rains in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: What's your favourite place there?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: The Green Mountain. My brothers adore the mountain walks.

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: And you?

lines.speaker: Khalid
lines.text: I hate them! What do you do in your free time?

lines.speaker: Hamza
lines.text: I play football and study for the exam!

title: Can I Try It On?
where: A clothes shop in a Riyadh mall in winter.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Good evening. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Yes, please. How much is this grey jacket?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: It's two hundred riyals.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Oh, that's expensive. Do you have a cheap one?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: This black jacket is a hundred and twenty riyals.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Can I try it on?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Of course. The changing rooms are over there.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: It's very comfortable, but it's large. Do you have a medium one?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Yes. Here you are.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: This is great. And how much are these T-shirts?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: They're thirty-five riyals each.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Two T-shirts and this jacket, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: That's a hundred and ninety riyals.

title: Can I Have Some Aspirin?
where: A chemist's, then the Post Office next door.

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: Good evening. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes. Can I have some aspirin, please? I have a headache.

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: Here you are. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes, toothpaste and shampoo, please.

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: That's thirty-two riyals.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Can I pay by credit card?

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: Of course. Put in your PIN, please.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Next, please!

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Hello. Can I send this parcel to Jeddah?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yes. Put it on the scales, please … That's forty riyals.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: And can I have a stamp for this postcard?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Here you are. Five riyals.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Thank you very much.

title: A Ticket to Al-Ahsa
where: The ticket office at the railway station in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Good morning. Can I have a ticket to Al-Ahsa, please?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Single or return?

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: A return ticket, please. I come back on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: That's 120 riyals.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Is the train fast?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yes. The journey is about three hours.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: What time is the next train?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: At eleven o'clock, from platform 2.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Is there a café on the train?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yes, there is. It's easy to find.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Great. My cousin meets me at the station.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Hurry! You can catch the eleven o'clock train.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Thanks! The train is quick and cheap!

title: Our New Neighbours
where: The street outside Nawaf's house. A new family is moving in.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Hello! Are you our new neighbours?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Yes, we are. I'm Fahad. We're from Hail.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Welcome! Why are you in Riyadh?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Because my father has a new job. He's the boss of a big company.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Welcome, Fahad. Who is in your family?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: My parents, my brother and the baby. And our cat!

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: A cat? I love cats. Can I see it?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Of course. Come and see us this evening.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: How many bedrooms are in your house?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Five. It's old, but it's very nice.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Play football with me and my friends!

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Thanks! You're very friendly.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Say hello to your father. I want to visit him.

title: Our New Apartment
where: Abdulaziz shows his friend Majed his family's new apartment.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Wow! Your new apartment is very nice.

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: Thanks! It's on the fifth floor.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: How many rooms are there?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: There are three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and two bathrooms.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is this the living room?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: Yes. There's a big sofa, and there are two armchairs.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: I like the lamp next to the sofa.

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: Come and see the kitchen. There's a new cooker and a big fridge.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is there a table in the kitchen?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: No, there isn't. We eat in the dining room.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Is there a garden?

lines.speaker: Abdulaziz
lines.text: No, but there's a park near our building.

title: Where Are My Car Keys?
where: Sunday afternoon at home. Waleed is late for college.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Sami, where are my car keys? I'm late!

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Are they on your desk?

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: No. There's a lamp and an alarm clock on my desk, but there aren't any keys.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Look in the drawer.

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: There are some pens in the drawer. No keys!

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Are they under the bed?

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: No. There are some trainers and my sports bag under the bed.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: What about behind the door?

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: Behind the door? No …

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Where's your laptop?

lines.speaker: Waleed
lines.text: It's on the sofa, next to the TV. Oh! My keys are next to my laptop!

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Ha ha! Go! You're late!

title: What's There in Riyadh?
where: A hotel lobby. Ziyad from Abha asks two Riyadh students about the city.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: This is my first time in Riyadh. What's your home town like?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: It's big and modern. It's very cosmopolitan, too.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Are there any museums?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Yes, there are. The National Museum is excellent.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Is there a castle?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Yes. Al Masmak is an old castle in the city centre.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: And what about entertainment?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: There are a lot of parks and malls. The Kingdom Tower is spectacular at night.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Are there any good restaurants?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Yes! There are all kinds of food: Saudi, Indian, Thai and Italian.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Is there a supermarket near my hotel?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Yes, there's one next to it.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Great! Riyadh is fantastic.

title: Is There a Pharmacy Near Here?
where: The bus station in Al Malaz. Hassan asks a man for help.

lines.speaker: Hassan
lines.text: Excuse me. Is there a pharmacy near here?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, there is. Go out of the bus station and turn right.

lines.speaker: Hassan
lines.text: Turn right. OK.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Go straight on for two minutes. Go past the bank.

lines.speaker: Hassan
lines.text: Go past the bank …

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Then turn left at the traffic lights. The pharmacy is on the corner, opposite the mosque.

lines.speaker: Hassan
lines.text: Thank you. Is the metro station far?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: It's about fifteen minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: Hassan
lines.text: Is there a car park there?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, there's a big car park next to it.

lines.speaker: Hassan
lines.text: Thanks a lot for the directions!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You're welcome.

title: My Favourite Season
where: The college garden. Three friends plan the weekend.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: What's your favourite season, Saud?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Winter. The weather is cool and fresh.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: I love spring. There are flowers in the desert.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: I don't like summer. It's very hot in Riyadh!

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: In summer, my family goes to Jeddah for water sports.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: What do you do there?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: I go sailing and fishing with my uncle.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: What's the weather like in autumn?

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: It's warm and sunny.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Let's go cycling this weekend!

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Good idea! The sky is blue, and it isn't hot.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: OK. Let's meet at the park at seven in the morning.

title: Famous People from the Past
where: Room 212. Mr. Ibrahim's class talks about history.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Today we're talking about famous people from the past. Who's your favourite?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Ibn Sina. He was a famous scientist and doctor.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Good. When was he born?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: He was born in 980. That's nine hundred and eighty.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: That was more than a thousand years ago!

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Yes, in the tenth century. And you, Fahad?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I like Abbas ibn Firnas. He tried to fly in the ninth century!

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Really? Was he a pilot?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: No, there weren't any planes then! He was a scientist and a poet too.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Where was he born?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: In Al-Andalus. He died in 887.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: When were you born, Fahad?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I was born in 2007. Two thousand and seven.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Good. Saying years is important for the exam!

title: The New Calendar
where: The classroom. Three students look at the college calendar on the wall.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Look at the new calendar. When is the final exam?

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: It's in December.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: And when does the second semester start?

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: In January.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: When is Ramadan next year?

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: In February and March. It moves every year because it follows the Hijri calendar.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: I love Ramadan. Fasting is difficult, but the evenings are wonderful.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: And after Ramadan, there's Eid. It's a holiday!

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Turki, when's your date of birth?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: It's 2 July 2006. And yours?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: 19 September 2007.

lines.speaker: Badr
lines.text: My favourite month is December, because the weather is cool.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Mine is August. It's the summer holiday!

title: After the Race
where: The college sports field on Sports Day.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Well done, everyone! Fahad, you were first!

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Thank you, Coach. I'm very happy with my gold medal.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: I was second. I was very close!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Yes, you were. And Majed was third.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: What's the prize for first?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: A new laptop. The second prize is a book.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Where was Turki?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: He was tenth. He was very tired.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: What's the date today, Coach?

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: It's the fifth of November.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: The next sports day is on the twentieth of March.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: I want to be first next time!

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: There's a long queue for water. Let's go!

title: Grandfather's Stories
where: Grandfather's house on Friday evening. Omar and Sami ask him questions.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Grandfather, where were you born?

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: I was born near Al-Ahsa in 1950.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Was your house big?

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: No, it wasn't. It was very small. There weren't any lamps. We had candles.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Was there a school?

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: There was a small primary school, but I didn't go. I worked with my father.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Were you the eldest son?

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: Yes, I was. I had seven brothers and sisters.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: What was your favourite toy?

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: We didn't have toys! We played with the sheep and goats under the palm trees.

lines.speaker: Sami
lines.text: Were you naughty?

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: Sometimes! My mother told us a lot of stories.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Life was simple then.

lines.speaker: Grandfather
lines.text: Yes, it was simple, but it was happy.

title: Where Were You Yesterday?
where: The college canteen on Thursday.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Hi Ali! Where were you yesterday?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: I went to Jeddah with my brother.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Really? How did you go?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: We took the train. We left at six in the morning.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: What did you do there?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: We went to the Corniche and saw the sea. Then we had lunch at a fish restaurant.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Who paid?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: I paid! It was a hundred and twenty riyals.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Did you buy anything?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: My brother bought some dates for our mother.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Was the weather nice?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: No, it was hot and wet. It was horrible! But we had a good time.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: When did you come back?

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: We came back at midnight. I'm very tired today!

title: A Relaxing Weekend
where: Sunday, before class. Three friends talk about the weekend.

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: Good morning, Sultan! How was your weekend?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: It was very relaxing. On Friday, I prayed at the mosque with my father.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Did you go out after that?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes. We visited my grandmother. My aunt cooked a big lunch.

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: Nice! What did you do in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: I played football with my cousins in the park.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Did you watch the match in the evening?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes, we watched it on TV. Al Hilal played very well.

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: And on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: I stayed at home. I cleaned my room and studied English for two hours.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Wow, you worked hard!

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes. I finished my homework at nine, and then I called my friend.

lines.speaker: Yasser
lines.text: My weekend wasn't relaxing. I travelled to Dammam and back!

title: Did You Finish the Homework?
where: Room 212 on Monday afternoon. Mr. Ibrahim checks the homework.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Good afternoon. Did you have a good weekend?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Not bad, thank you. I didn't do much.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Did you finish the homework?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Yes, I did. I finished it last night.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: I didn't, sorry. I fell asleep at eight o'clock!

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Really? Did you stay up late on Thursday?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Yes, I did. I watched the match. My team won, so I was lucky!

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: What was the result?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Two–one. The goalkeeper was amazing.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: OK, Turki. Please finish it tonight. Did you study this morning?

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: No, I didn't. I had a nap!

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Nawaf, can I borrow a pen? I didn't bring my pencil case.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Sure. I can lend you one.

lines.speaker: Mr. Ibrahim
lines.text: Good. And nobody forgets the homework next time!

title: At the Sports Centre
where: The college canteen. Saleh asks Faisal about the class trip.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Where did you go last Thursday, Faisal?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Our class went to a big sports centre in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: What did you do there?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: In the morning, I went to the swimming pool. Then I tried bowling.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Were you good?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: No! I wasn't very good. But it was fun.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: What did you do after lunch?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: We went to the ice rink. It was my first time ice-skating.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Did you fall down?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Yes, three times! Our teacher didn't skate. He sat and watched us.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: I love padel. I play on the new courts every Saturday.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Can you teach me? I want to try a new leisure activity.

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Sure! Bring a towel and some water.

title: At the Tourist Office
where: The tourist office in AlUla. Ahmed and his father want information.

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Good morning. Welcome to the tourist office.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Hello. Can we have a map and a brochure, please?

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Here you are. Do you want a bus tour?

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Yes, please! What can we see?

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: You can see the old town and some ancient rocks. The rocks have writing on them.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: How old are they?

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: More than two thousand years old!

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: What are the opening hours?

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: From eight in the morning until six in the evening. The bus tour is ninety riyals.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Is there a viewpoint?

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Yes. The view at sunset is amazing.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: We came here ten years ago. It was very different then!

lines.speaker: Worker
lines.text: Yes, it's busy now. Many tourists come from Europe and China.

title: Dinner at the Diner
where: Sunday at college. Ibrahim asks Sultan about Saturday night.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: Did you go out last Saturday?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes. My brothers and I went to a new diner in the mall.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: Did you book a table?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Yes, we did. We sat outside because the weather was cool.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: What did you eat?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: I had pasta with chicken. My brother had roast beef.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: Was it tasty?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: The pasta was great, but the roast beef was a little cold.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: What did you drink?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Orange juice. Then we went to a coffee bar.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: Did you have a coffee?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: No, I didn't. I had a lemon and mint drink.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: How much did you pay?

lines.speaker: Sultan
lines.text: Two hundred and ten riyals for everything.

lines.speaker: Ibrahim
lines.text: Next time, try the shawarma place near my house. It's cheap!

title: What Can a Pilot Do?
where: Jobs Day at college. Captain Nasser answers students' questions.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Captain Nasser, what can a pilot do?

lines.speaker: Captain Nasser
lines.text: A pilot can fly a plane. I can fly a jumbo jet.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Can you speak English?

lines.speaker: Captain Nasser
lines.text: Yes, I can. I speak English fluently. All pilots need English.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Can you repair an engine?

lines.speaker: Captain Nasser
lines.text: No, I can't. That's the job of a technician.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: I want to be an aircraft mechanic. I can use tools.

lines.speaker: Captain Nasser
lines.text: Good. Mechanics work in the hangar. They check the wings and the engines.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Can an interpreter work at the airport?

lines.speaker: Captain Nasser
lines.text: Yes. Interpreters help passengers from other countries.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: What can we do now?

lines.speaker: Captain Nasser
lines.text: Study English every day. One day, you can work at an airport too!

title: The College Champion
where: The college library at the break.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Talal, can you play chess?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, I can. I play really well. I'm the college champion!

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Wow! When did you start?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: When I was eight. Now I play online every evening.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Can you beat our teacher?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Yes, I can! Last month, I beat a player from Argentina.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Can you swim?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: A little bit. I can't swim fast.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: I can play computer games, but I can't play chess.

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Do you want to try? It isn't difficult.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: OK! Is it a board game or an online game?

lines.speaker: Talal
lines.text: Both. We can play on a board or on a tablet.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Let's play on a board. I like real games.

title: A Video Call to the US
where: Friday evening. Majed and his father make a video call to Yousef in the US.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Hello, Yousef! Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: Yes, I can! The Wi-Fi is good today. I can see you clearly.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Hello, son. How is the US?

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: It's great, Dad. I study mostly in the library. Now I speak English more fluently.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: I use the Net for study too. I download English apps.

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: Good. Do you read my blog?

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Yes, every week! You write very well.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: And Majed types very fast now.

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: Be careful on social media, Majed. Don't tell anyone your password.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: I know. And I don't click on strange links.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: This video call is free. It's amazing!

lines.speaker: Yousef
lines.text: Let's talk again next Friday. Bye!

title: A Dangerous Sport?
where: The college car park. Hamad asks Bader about motor racing.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Bader, is motor racing a dangerous sport?

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: It can be dangerous. The cars are very fast and very heavy.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Are you a careful driver?

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Yes, I am. I always wear a strong helmet.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Do you race on city roads?

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: No! Fast driving on a city road is very dangerous. I only race in a safe place.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: What do you study at college?

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Science and history. I want to be an engineer.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: I want to design safe cars. Cars are safer now, but the driver is the most important part.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: My favourite subject is geography. I like maps.

lines.speaker: Bader
lines.text: Is geography difficult?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: No, it's an easy subject. But I don't like art!

title: What's the Matter?
where: The football pitch, then the college clinic.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Hamad, what's the matter?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I fell down in the match. My arm hurts.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Oh no! Can you move it?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: A little bit. It hurts a lot.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Let's go to the college clinic.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Hello. What's the problem?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I had a small accident. I hurt my arm.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Let me see … It isn't broken. But you need a plaster on this cut.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Thank you. My knee hurts too.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Put some ice on it, and rest for two days.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: What a bad day! You missed the bus this morning too.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes, and the ticket machine at the metro was broken!

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Take care, and get well soon.

title: Shops Near the College
where: The main gate. Ziyad is a new student. Omar and Faisal help him.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: I'm new here. What shops are near the college?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: There's a small bookshop next to the main gate. You can buy notebooks there.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Great. Where can I get a coffee?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: There's a coffee shop opposite the bookshop. It opens at seven.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Is there a bakery?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Yes, near the coffee shop. The bread is fresh and cheap.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: I need some medicine for my headache.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: You can buy medicine at the pharmacy, next to the supermarket.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Is there a cash machine around here?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Yes, there's one outside the supermarket.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: And a barber's? I need a haircut!

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: There's one behind the laundry. It's good and cheap.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Thanks! Anything else?

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Yes. In the supermarket, pay at the till, not at the door!

title: At the Sandwich Shop
where: A sandwich shop opposite the college at lunchtime.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Good afternoon. What would you like?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: I'd like a chicken sandwich, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Would you like onion and tomato?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Tomato, yes. No onion, thank you.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Mayonnaise?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Just a little. Not too much, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Would you like something to drink?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Yes. I'd like a bottle of mineral water.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Sparkling or normal?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Normal, please. And I'd like some olives for my lunch box.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Small or large?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Small, please. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: That's twenty-two riyals.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Here you are. Thank you!

title: A Table for Two
where: A restaurant on Olaya Street. Saud and Mansour order dinner.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Good evening, Sir. A table for two?

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Are you ready to order?

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Yes. For starters, I'd like some soup.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Lentil or tomato?

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Lentil, please.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Do you have any fish?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Yes, we have some grilled salmon. It comes with rice.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Great. And a mixed salad on the side, please.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: For mains, I'd like chicken kebab. Do you have any garlic sauce?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Sorry, we don't have any garlic sauce today. We have some lemon sauce.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: That's fine. And a jug of water, please.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Any dessert? We have apple pie and chocolate cake.

lines.speaker: Saud
lines.text: Chocolate cake for me! Can we pay by card?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Yes, cash or card. Thank you, Sir.

title: What Does That Sign Mean?
where: King Khalid International Airport. Ali is travelling with his father.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Dad, look at that sign. It says PULL.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Yes. Pull the door, don't push it.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: What does OUT OF ORDER mean?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: It means the lift isn't working. Let's take the stairs.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Can I go through that door?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: No. It says STAFF ONLY. Only airport workers can go in.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Can I take photos here?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Look, the sign says NO PHOTOS. You can't take photos here.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: OK. Where do we wait?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: At the gate. There's a sign: PLEASE WAIT HERE.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: What's that green sign?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: That's an EXIT sign. In an emergency, follow the green signs.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: And DON'T FORGET YOUR BAGS!

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Good boy!

title: Uncle Faisal's Marathon
where: Friday lunch at home. Nawaf and his friend Hamad talk to Uncle Faisal.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Uncle Faisal, how far is a marathon?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: It's forty-two kilometres.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Wow! How did you feel after the race?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Tired, but very happy. I crossed the finish line in five hours.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: What time do you get up?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: At dawn. I run ten kilometres before work.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: And in the evening?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: After sunset, I ride my bike in the park.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: I eat too many sweets. Is that bad?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Yes. Don't eat too much sugar. Eat smaller meals and a lot of fruit.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I drink too much cola.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Drink water. Then you have more energy.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: OK! I'm going to walk ten thousand steps every day.

title: Winter Clothes
where: A clothes shop in the mall. Majed and Nawaf are shopping for winter.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Good evening. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Yes. I'd like a shemagh. A red one, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Here you are. And for you?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: I need a warm scarf and some gloves.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: What colour?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Dark blue or purple.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Purple? You never wear purple!

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: That's true. Dark blue, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: What size are you?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Large.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Look at that man. What's he wearing?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: He's wearing a grey suit and a blue tie. Maybe he's a manager.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Would you like to put on the gloves?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Yes … They're perfect. How much are they?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: The scarf and the gloves are ninety riyals.

title: What's Happening in Class?
where: Omar is at home with a cold. At the break, he calls Faisal in class.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Hi Faisal! What are you doing at the moment?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: I'm sitting in the classroom. It's the break.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: What's happening in class today?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: The teacher is explaining the Present Continuous. We're recording a video about it.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Really? What's Turki doing?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: He's standing up and waving at you! Say hello, Turki.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Hi Omar! I'm holding the camera. We're making a secret video for you!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Ha ha! What's the teacher doing right now?

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: He's looking for his marker. Wait … someone is knocking on the door.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: It's the coordinator. Everyone is standing up.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: OK. Go back to class! I'm lying down. I have a cold.

lines.speaker: Faisal
lines.text: Get well soon! Bye!

title: On the Train to Qassim
where: A phone call. Nawaf is on the train. His father calls him.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Hello, Nawaf. Where are you?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: I'm on the train, Dad. We're travelling to Qassim.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Who are you with?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Majed and Saleh. We're using public transport because there's a big traffic jam on the motorway.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Good idea. What are you doing now?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: I'm sitting by the window. Majed is drinking an espresso, and Saleh is sleeping!

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Where are you staying tonight?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: In a small hostel. We aren't spending much money.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Is the hostel nice?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: I don't know yet. We booked a room for three. The reception is open all night.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: What are you doing tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: We're visiting Majed's uncle. He has a country house with a big farm.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Have a good trip, son!

title: The Busy Airport
where: The airport. Abdullah, his father and his cousin Ziyad watch the planes.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Look, Abdullah. They're building a new airport in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: Wow! Is it big?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Yes. It's going to be one of the biggest airports in the world.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Every day, hundreds of planes arrive and depart here.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: Today it's very busy. Why?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: The holidays are starting. Many families are travelling.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: Uncle, do you remember the old airport?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Yes. It was small, and it closed at night.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: Look! The passengers are getting off that plane.

lines.speaker: Ziyad
lines.text: And those people are getting on the bus.

lines.speaker: Abdullah
lines.text: My teenage brother wants to work here. He's studying hard.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Good. He works hard, so he can do well and be successful.

title: Helping Is Worth It
where: Thursday evening at home. Saad is ill. His brother Mansour is going out.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Saad, what's the matter? You don't look well.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: I have a cold and a sore throat. I'm not playing football tonight.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Do you have a fever?

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: No, I don't. But I'm coughing and sneezing a lot.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Drink hot lemon and honey. Get better soon!

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Thanks. Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: I'm going to the charity. I'm a volunteer there.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: What do you do there?

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: We give food and blankets to homeless people and poor families.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Are you carrying boxes today?

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Yes. It's hard work, but I'm very pleased. Helping people is worth it.

lines.speaker: Saad
lines.text: Next month, I want to donate my old clothes.

lines.speaker: Mansour
lines.text: Great idea! That can cheer up a lot of people.

title: At the Check-in Desk
where: King Khalid International Airport at night. Nawaf and Fahad check in.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Good evening. Can I see your passports, please?

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Here you are. We're going to Paris.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Thank you. Do you have any luggage?

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Yes, one suitcase each. And I have this rucksack.

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: The rucksack can go on the plane with you. Here are your boarding passes.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Is the flight on time?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: There's a small delay. It's now leaving at eleven fifteen.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: We have a connection in Dubai. Is that OK?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Yes. You have two hours there.

lines.speaker: Nawaf
lines.text: Where are the departures?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Go straight, then turn left. Your gate is in Terminal 2.

lines.speaker: Fahad
lines.text: Is it an overnight flight?

lines.speaker: Officer
lines.text: Yes. You land in Paris at seven in the morning. Have a good trip!

title: After the Final Exam
where: The college library. Hamad and Abdulrahman talk about the future.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Abdulrahman, what are you going to do after the final exam?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: I'm going to rest for a week! Then I'm going to start my aviation course.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: What are you going to study?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: Engines and aircraft. I hope to be a technician.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: When are you going to graduate?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: In 2029. I'm going to get a diploma and an English certificate.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Great plans! What did you want to be when you were a child?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: A pilot. But now I imagine a different career.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Are you going to work abroad?

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: Maybe one day. First, I'm going to work in Riyadh.

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I'm going to apply for a job at the airport next month.

lines.speaker: Abdulrahman
lines.text: All the best, Hamad!

title: A Scholarship to Canada
where: The classroom. Saleh tells his teacher and his friend Turki his news.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Saleh, I hear you got a scholarship. Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Thank you! I'm going to study in Canada.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: What are you going to study?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Engineering. In the first semester, I'm going to take Physics and chemistry.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Are all the lectures in English?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Yes, they are. That's why I did a lot of revision for my English exam.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Where are you going to live?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: On the campus. It has a library, a gym and a laboratory.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Do you know your lecturer's name?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: Not yet. I'm going to meet him on the first day.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Are you nervous?

lines.speaker: Saleh
lines.text: A little bit, but I'm very excited!

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Take good notes, and do every project on time.

title: Uncle Hamad's Safari
where: Friday evening. Ali and Majed ask Uncle Hamad about his holidays.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Uncle Hamad, where did you go last year?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I went on safari in South Africa.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Did you see any lions?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes! I saw lions, zebras and elephants. A local guide drove the jeep.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Was it hot?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: There was a lot of sunshine, but the evenings were cool.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Did you buy a souvenir?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes, I bought a wooden elephant for Ali.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Thank you! Where are you going to go next year?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I'm going to visit Zambia. I'm going to see a famous waterfall.

lines.speaker: Majed
lines.text: Do you need a visa?

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: Yes. I already have it.

lines.speaker: Ali
lines.text: Don't forget your sun cream and sunglasses!

lines.speaker: Hamad
lines.text: I'm going to pack them tonight!

title: Same to You!
where: The last lesson before the holiday. Mr. Said says goodbye to the class.

lines.speaker: Mr. Said
lines.text: Have a good weekend, everyone! See you next week.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Same to you, Mr. Said!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Atishoo!

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Bless you, Omar!

lines.speaker: Mr. Said
lines.text: Are you OK, Omar? You have a cold. Get well soon!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Said. And thank you for your help this semester.

lines.speaker: Mr. Said
lines.text: It was my pleasure.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: I'm going to Jeddah tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Mr. Said
lines.text: Have a safe journey!

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Thanks! Jeddah is warm all year round.

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Sorry, I can't come to the class dinner tonight.

lines.speaker: Turki
lines.text: Never mind. Take care!

lines.speaker: Mr. Said
lines.text: All the best in the final exam, everyone!

lines.speaker: Omar
lines.text: Thank you. See you again soon!
